prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: specific illustrated catalog contact sheet for original female anime/game character designs.
Primary request: illustrate every listed feature faithfully, each as a DISTINCT reference example.
Layout: EXACTLY 4 equal columns and 4 equal rows in a regular rectangular grid. Cells read left to right then top to bottom. 16 illustrated cells; any remaining trailing cells must be completely blank. Each cell is self-contained with generous gutters. Exact cell ID in small crisp dark sans-serif type at the top left. No other text, no title, no watermark, no logos.
Style: polished professional anime production reference drawings; fine clean outlines, restrained flat colors with minimal cel shadows, light warm ivory background. Detailed enough to identify the named feature. Consistent drawing quality; Adult women aged 25+ where a person is needed; product objects and adult neutral forms where specified, with diverse natural skin tones where relevant. Clothes and bodies fully visible within their specified framing, no overlapping cells, no cropped feet, no generic placeholder symbols.
Subject direction: ACTUAL HEADPHONE/EARPHONE WEARING REFERENCES on clearly mature ADULT women age25-40, plain opaque high-neck grey tops and natural adult faces. Portrait from complete crown/headband to upper chest; show the full device including ears, headband, neckband, folded/rotated cup, microphone and visible cable route. Hair swept or tucked away from the VIEWER-SIDE EAR. Match the EXACT side or three-quarter view in each cell; keep entire head/headgear and device inside cell with generous margin. Ear cups physically contact the correct part of the ear, earbuds sit in the ear concha, earhooks go BEHIND the pinna rather than through flesh. All HP017-HP032 and HP013 need ONE circular closeup inset at lower-right showing the SAME VIEWER-SIDE EAR and SAME WORN device, with realistic contact and cable routing, never a detached product. Make small earbuds large enough to identify. HP025 bone-conduction pad sits IN FRONT OF EAR on cheekbone, open canal, posterior band; HP026 air-conduction driver stays OUTSIDE ear canal; HP027 C-shaped clip links front speaker and rear battery around PINNA EDGE, no piercing. Distinguish these three carefully. Communications microphones stop beside mouth with a small gap, never go in mouth or nose. Thin cables descend toward shoulder, never encircle throat. No swapped left/right inset, logos, generic recolors, fantasy hardware except explicitly HP015, no child features, no irrelevant jewellery or hair bows. One ID only per cell, no extra text.
Specific ordered cells:
Cell 1, label HP001: closed-back over-ear headphones / 包耳封闭式耳机. Visible feature: 大椭圆厚耳垫完整包住耳廓，封闭外壳和可调滑杆清楚，头梁压在头顶。
Cell 2, label HP002: compact on-ear headphones / 小耳罩压耳式耳机. Visible feature: 小圆耳垫压在外耳表面，耳廓边缘露出，细头梁与小罩尺寸区别于包耳式。
Cell 3, label HP003: open-back grille headphones / 网罩开放式大耳机. Visible feature: 大耳罩外侧为可见细金属网格，双叉支架连接头梁，耳垫包耳；开放指外壳结构。
Cell 4, label HP004: suspension-headband headphones / 双梁悬挂式耳机. Visible feature: 一条柔性宽内头带贴住头顶，上方另有两根细框架拱梁，圆耳罩在两侧。
Cell 5, label HP005: retro foam-pad headphones / 复古海绵压耳耳机. Visible feature: 极细金属头梁、橙色薄海绵圆耳垫与简洁塑料连接件，细耳机线自然垂下。
Cell 6, label HP006: hinged portable headphones / 折叠铰链便携耳机. Visible feature: 中号耳罩正常戴在耳上，头梁两端的折叠铰链和旋转接头外露，不画成收纳状态。
Cell 7, label HP007: single-cup DJ monitoring wear / DJ单耳监听戴法. Visible feature: 旋转头梁斜跨头顶，一侧耳罩紧贴耳部，另一侧耳罩转向头后；无手遮住结构。
Cell 8, label HP008: headphones resting around neck / 双耳罩挂颈戴法. Visible feature: 耳机从耳上取下挂在颈部，两个耳罩朝前置于锁骨两侧，头梁绕颈后，两耳完整露出。
Cell 9, label HP009: gaming headset with boom mic / 电竞双耳麦克风耳机. Visible feature: 厚耳罩、简单几何灯条与短鹅颈麦克风，麦头停在嘴角旁，正常成人耳机无品牌。
Cell 10, label HP010: broadcast monitoring headset / 广播监听通话耳麦. Visible feature: 黑色大包耳监听罩和粗稳麦杆，泡棉麦头位于嘴边留有间隙，单侧螺旋线向肩下走。
Cell 11, label HP011: aviation communication headset / 航空通话耳麦. Visible feature: 宽软头垫、双金属支架、浅灰厚耳罩与泡棉麦头，可见独立导线在肩前垂下。
Cell 12, label HP012: helmet-rail communication headset / 头盔导轨通讯耳麦. Visible feature: 中性深色无标志头盔，两侧导轨短支臂固定耳罩，不用头顶头梁；下颌带与嘴侧麦杆清楚。
Cell 13, label HP013: stage in-ear monitors with cheek mic / 舞台入耳监听与耳麦. Visible feature: 透明小型入耳监听塞由细线绕耳后，另有肤色细麦挂从耳后沿面颊至嘴角，两者为不同部件。
Cell 14, label HP014: cat-ear decorated headphones / 猫耳装饰头戴耳机. Visible feature: 普通包耳耳机的头梁上有两枚小三角猫耳装饰，发型和真实人耳正常，没有生物兽耳。
Cell 15, label HP015: fictional mechanical earcup headset / 科幻机械耳罩装置. Visible feature: 原创科幻耳罩由头后硬弧梁固定，外罩有分层机械片与短天线，耳罩和皮肤接触关系明确；幻想设计。
Cell 16, label HP016: knit audio earmuff headphones / 针织保暖音频耳罩. Visible feature: 针织包覆头梁与毛绒圆耳罩，罩侧有小音频控制钮和短接线，明确是带音频单元的保暖耳机。
Critical constraints: Do not substitute a generic example. The named feature must actually be observable. Read the Chinese feature description if the English phrase is ambiguous. Keep visible structural differences. No character brands or franchise resemblance.
Canvas: large PORTRAIT contact sheet, preferably 2048 by 3072 pixels. Exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, thin straight visible grey separator rules at precisely one quarter, half and three quarters of each axis. SIXTEEN cells, each ID once in exact row-major order. No title/footer. Complete figure/form/head with all garments and hair ends contained in its own cell. Do not cross separators. Each cell must show the distinct listed condition or costume instead of recolors. No watermarks or brands.
Required camera views: HP001 斜前面; HP002 斜侧面; HP003 侧面略前; HP004 斜前面; HP005 斜侧面; HP006 斜侧面; HP007 斜前面; HP008 正面略侧; HP009 斜前面; HP010 斜侧面; HP011 斜前面; HP012 斜侧面; HP013 侧面略前; HP014 斜前面; HP015 斜侧面; HP016 斜前面
Final canvas is PORTRAIT 1024x1536 with exactly4 columns x4 rows. Show mature adult portraits in grey opaque high-neck tops, complete head/headband and every device with margin. Small devices have the specified circular same-ear closeups, no detached product inset. Keep each ID legible and unique.

edit_prompt: Edit ONLY HP026 (row3 column2), HP027 (row3 column3), and HP031 (row4 column3), including their circular insets, in this 1024x1536 4x4 headphone wearing sheet. Preserve ALL other13 cells, exact IDs, grid rules, adult models, neutral grey opaque high-neck clothes and drawing style. HP026: realistic OPEN-EAR AIR-CONDUCTION EARHOOK, a thin flexible hook passes behind the upper ear; its small slim oval speaker is held OUTSIDE and just in front of the ear canal with a visible air gap. Expose the canal opening and concha; NO silicone nozzle, no plug in canal and no bone pad against cheek. Show clearly in matching same-ear inset. HP027: realistic CUFF/CLIP-ON OPEN-EAR earbud. A short thin U/C bridge loops ONLY around OUTER PINNA EDGE at mid-lower ear; a small shiny spherical speaker rests OUTSIDE at the edge of concha, a larger oblong battery behind pinna, and the EAR CANAL OPENING remains visibly free with a small air gap. It is NOT an earhook around the ear top and NOT an in-ear bean. Main and inset show EXACT SAME bridge, sphere and rear battery at same location. HP031: make the adult head slightly more frontal so its MONO communications headset clearly has ONE round small ear cup on viewer-right ear and a small flat HEAD PAD on the opposite temple ABOVE the other UNCOVERED EAR. Fine headband runs across crown to pad, never two earcups. Retain thin boom beside mouth and correct inset of worn earcup. No additional text or device, no other changes.
